values.binNote: The wiki states only the bonus 15%-55% AD ratio (on top of the attack's own normal AD damage). TrundleTrollSmash#TotalDamage / ADScaling instead carries 1.15-1.55 (i.e. 100% AD + the same 15-55% bonus), because the calculation apparently folds the base attack's AD damage into this instance's total rather than treating them as separate damage sources. Stating the wiki's 0.15-0.55 bonus ratio here since that's what the tooltip describes as this ability's added damage.

SappedAD stores the reduction as a negative subtraction (-10 to -20); the wiki states the magnitude of the reduction as a positive number, which is the same value with the sign convention of 'reduce by'.

mechanics.claim: Chomp empowers the next basic attack, gives it an uncancellable windup, and applies bonus physical damage and a slow on hit.
mechanics.quote: empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 7 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|25 '''bonus''' range}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|slow}} the target by 75% for {{fd|0.1}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Trundle gains the bonus AD even if the empowered attack is dodged, blocked, missed while blinded, or blocked by spell shield.
mechanics.quote: ''Chomp'' will still incur the {{sti|{{as|attack damage}}}} increase for '''Trundle''' even if the attack is {{tip|dodged}}, {{tip|blocked}}, missed while he is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, or it is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield only blocks the attack damage reduction and slow, not the bonus damage/bonus AD to Trundle.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the attack damage reduction and {{tip|slow}}.

mechanics.claim: The target's bonus AD cannot be reduced below 0 by the debuff; total AD is still reduced accordingly.
mechanics.quote: If the attack damage reduction would reduce the target's {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} below {{as|0|ad}}, the target's {{as|'''base''' attack damage}} value is unaffected, but their {{as|'''total''' attack damage}} will still be reduced.

mechanics.claim: Chomp resets Trundle's basic attack timer.
The cooldown starts after the empowered attack lands (post-effect), not on cast.
